name: Hannah Zhang
source: Hannah is a software engineer living in San Francisco, who worked at a startup with Jake and Nikhil for a time. She is one of Jake's best friends, his closest confidant, and is always happy to help force and support Jake through stressful situations. She quickly grows into more of a managerial role at her corporate job, thanks to her leadership experience at their startup.
